title: Minimalist racing game
author: shimroot
selftext:
Made vectorgp.run - a minimalist browser racing game using the vector mechanics from the racetrack pen and paper game. 

There are several tracks available as well as two play modes with ranking. Once you get used to the “outrageous controls” as someone put it - it’s actually quite fun.

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: This is quite good, nice work!

comments.author: Embarrassed_Split236
comments.body: Pretty cool, only thing I would like is a way to skip the start lights to get back into the game quicker

replies.author: shimroot
replies.body: I'm not sure I want to get rid of the start lights in time trial, but it's on the list to make it go through it faster, it feels like it's taking forever. Until then you can try "session" mode to get back to speed faster, but it's a bit of a different beast.
